description: smartgis third_party pins. Sources fetch into .src/<name>. GIS overlap copies mgis Gitea URL + rev. git_url is the Gitea pin; git_url_fallbacks are upstream until the Gitea repo exists.

gitea_mirror.note: Same org Gitea as mogu/mgis. Existing mirrors are reused; do not re-upload. Override with GITEA_MIRROR_BASE / GITEA_TOKEN if wiring authenticated create/push.

packages.name: glog
packages.note: Reused mogu pin (v0.6.0). Gitea already has this tag; not re-uploaded.

packages.name: googletest
packages.note: Reused mogu pin (v1.14.0). Gitea already has this tag; not re-uploaded. gtest_force_shared_crt=ON for mgis MSVC /MD.

packages.name: benchmark
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import of vendored googlebenchmark (not mogu benchmark v1.8.3; that Gitea repo is empty).

packages.name: asio
packages.note: Standalone header-only ASIO (ASIO_STANDALONE). Gitea ccl/asio exists; GitHub fallback if the tag is missing. Do not add Boost.Asio. Used by src/net.

packages.name: cpp-httplib
packages.note: Header-only HTTP(S) client/server. HTTPS needs CPPHTTPLIB_OPENSSL_SUPPORT + //third_party:openssl (sync_openssl_win.ps1).

packages.name: openssl
packages.note: Not fetched from git. Windows: winget install ShiningLight.OpenSSL.Dev then powershell -File third_party/tools/sync_openssl_win.ps1 → third_party/.install (and out/third_party junction). GN label //third_party:openssl. OpenSSL 3+ required by cpp-httplib.

packages.name: sqlite3
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded.

packages.name: geos
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. LGPL — WKT display only.

packages.name: PROJ
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded.

packages.name: SQLiteCpp
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded.

packages.name: libspatialindex
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Dead product link — keep for third_party_all.

packages.name: gdal
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Frozen display adapter.

packages.name: libspatialite
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Dead product link — keep for third_party_all.

packages.name: SpatiaLiteCpp
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded.

packages.name: CxImage
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Compiled by thin //third_party/CxImage GN from .src/CxImage, not install.py.

packages.name: wtl8.0
packages.note: Reused existing Gitea import; not re-uploaded. Header-only WTL in .src/wtl8.0.

packages.name: flycube
packages.note: Mirrored to Gitea from local FlyCube checkout (was shallow; unshallowed then pushed). Low-level DX12/Vulkan/Metal API behind render::rhi. Sources in .src/flycube.

packages.name: assimp
packages.note: Gitea 404 as of 2026-09-13. Pin v5.4.3. Junction a local tree to .src/assimp (Importer.hpp). Do not GitHub-fetch from product TUs; Assimp stays off until that include exists.

packages.name: tinygltf
packages.note: Gitea 404 as of 2026-09-13. Pin v2.9.3. GitHub tag archive extracted to .src/tinygltf (tiny_gltf.h). Used only for 3D Tiles content, never as a tileset.

packages.name: khronos_gl
packages.note: Khronos OpenGL extension headers (MIT). Sources in .src/khronos_gl; thin GN at third_party/khronos_gl. Uploaded to Gitea (SHA e40d74db…).

packages.name: ed25519
packages.note: tweetnacl/ed25519 used by src/base. Sources in .src/ed25519; thin GN at third_party/ed25519. Uploaded to Gitea.

packages.name: antlr4
packages.note: Runtime-only ANTLR 4.13.2 C++ (BSD-3). Gitea ccl/antlr4 exists but is empty; official source zip. Do not vendor the Java tool jar in the product DLL. GN //third_party/antlr4:antlr4_runtime.

packages.name: eigen
packages.note: Header-only Eigen 3.4.0 (MPL2). SparseLU backend for orthogrid Laplace / elliptic grid generation only — not geo Vector types. Reused existing Gitea mirror; not re-uploaded. No cmake install.
